comment: What npm audit reports for the tree the release actually installs. That tree is not the one this file used to describe: the release installs semantic-release through cycjimmy/semantic-release-action, which runs `npm ci` against its own committed package-lock.json and only then installs the pinned version on top, so audit.yml now checks the action out at the sha release.yml pins and performs those three steps. It used to start from `npm init -y`, where npm resolves every transitive fresh and takes the newest each range allows, and that tree carried 12 advisories and no critical against this one's 28 and two. The figures below are therefore a correction of what was measured and not a worsening of what runs: nothing in the pipeline changed between the 12 and the 28 (#260). The counts are a function of two identifiers in this repository. Compared path by path on 2026-10-06, 531 of the tree's 532 packages are verbatim from the action's lockfile and the single difference is semantic-release itself, 25.0.2 from the lockfile raised to the pinned 25.0.9 — so these numbers move when a sha or a version is bumped here, and not when npm publishes. The two criticals are handlebars, JavaScript injection via AST type confusion, and tar, arbitrary file creation via hardlink path traversal, both held at their vulnerable versions by the action's lockfile. The 23 high are @isaacs/brace-expansion, @semantic-release/changelog, @semantic-release/commit-analyzer, @semantic-release/git, @semantic-release/github, @semantic-release/npm, @semantic-release/release-notes-generator, brace-expansion, braces, glob, http-cache-semantics, ip-address, js-yaml, lodash, lodash-es, micromatch, minimatch, npm, pacote, picomatch, semantic-release, sigstore and undici; the moderates are @sigstore/core and postcss-selector-parser, and the low is diff. Most are reached through npm-as-a-library, which semantic-release depends on. The job fails when a count rises, not when a count is non-zero: none of these is this project's to fix. The sixteen the old tree did not show sit inside the action's lockfile and only a bump of its sha can move them; the twelve it did show were tried on 2026-10-06 and neither upgrading nor fixing is available, since 25.0.9 is the latest published version and `npm audit fix` resolves none of them, with semantic-release@15.14.0 — a major downgrade of the release machinery, which A44 declined and A28's pinning exists to prevent — npm's only other suggestion. Raising a number here is a deliberate act and belongs in the commit message that raises it.
toolchain: semantic-release@25.0.9 installed by cycjimmy/semantic-release-action@b12c8f6015dc215fe37bc154d4ad456dd3833c90, both read from .github/workflows/release.yml. Measured locally under node 26.9.0 and npm 12.0.2 where CI pins node 24; 531 of the 532 packages come from the action's lockfile, which no node version re-resolves.
